# azion_workload_deployments (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "azion_workload_deployments" "example" {
  workload_id = "12345"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workload_id` (String) Numeric identifier of the Workload.

### Read-Only

- `deployments_count` (Number) The total number of deployments.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source.
- `results` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Status of the deployment.
- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp of the deployment.
- `current` (Boolean) Whether this is the current deployment.
- `id` (Number) The deployment identifier.
- `last_editor` (String) The last editor of the deployment.
- `last_modified` (String) Last modified timestamp of the deployment.
- `name` (String) Name of the deployment.
- `strategy` (Attributes) Deployment strategy configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--strategy))

<a id="nestedatt--results--strategy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.strategy`

Read-Only:

- `attributes` (Attributes) Strategy attributes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--strategy--attributes))
- `type` (String) Type of deployment strategy.

<a id="nestedatt--results--strategy--attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.strategy.attributes`

Read-Only:

- `application` (Number) Application ID for the deployment.
- `custom_page` (Number) Custom page ID for the deployment.
- `firewall` (Number) Firewall ID for the deployment.
